$comment: Canonical order payload matching BasketCheckoutEvent shape (BuildingBlocks.Messaging/Events/BasketCheckoutEvent.cs). Used by create_mock_order to seed the customer, addresses and payment payload of an order in OrderDb. The address is a ComplexProperty on Orders (DeliveryAddress_* / BillingAddress_* columns) — there is NO OrderAddresses table. The `orderItems` array below is ONLY the fallback used when `catalog-seed.json` holds no items; the normal path picks the line items from the catalog seed. Status defaults to 'Pending'; can be overridden.
